description: 30 CEDARWOOD RINGS FOR THE WARDROBE – NATURAL MOTH PROTECTION AND WARDROBE FRAGRANCE BY INOVIDA: Clothes moths naturally avoid the scent of cedarwood essential oil as they find it unpleasant.
